body:
Source: GitHub issue #1055 (follow-up from #1043 / PR #1046). Now that Wave 6 Batch 6B has fully eradicated all allowlisted fleet test suites, the ALLOWLIST set in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs has reached exactly 0 entries (new Set([])).

To permanently lock this milestone and prevent any future PR or agent under pressure from expanding the allowlist or bypassing fixture cleanup obligations:
1. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Add explicit assertion in 'the allowlist may only shrink' test:
     assert.equal(ALLOWLIST.size, 0, 'ALLOWLIST has reached 0 and must remain empty — fixture leaking is 100% eradicated across the repository');
   - Update file header JSDoc comments to document that the allowlist was completely eradicated (0 files leaking across the repository) and that any addition to ALLOWLIST is forbidden by contract.
2. Verification:
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0 (10/10 tests pass).
   - Verify that adding a dummy entry to ALLOWLIST immediately triggers a failure.
   - All workspace scripts tests pass: node scripts/run-tests.mjs scripts.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1 ALLOWLIST in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs is asserted to have size 0.
- AC2 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs passes all tests.
- AC3 A non-empty ALLOWLIST is rejected by the test runner.
- AC4 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: test(scripts): assert ALLOWLIST is empty and lock tmp-fixture boundary (#1055)
